about: K2 push-e2e-v2 test vectors: format 2 (the bigger buckets). Generated by the K2 daemon's real seal code (crates/k2-core/src/push/vectors.rs, build_v2) with the SAME recipient key and PSK as e2e_push_vectors.json and a fixed ephemeral seed per case. Identical to format 1 (suite, info, PSK, psk_id, padding rule, plaintext schema with "v":1) except: blob byte 0 = 0x02 (in the AAD), the alert plaintext is padded to 2880 bytes and the nudge to 1024, so a blob is 2963 / 1107 bytes = 3951 / 1476 base64url characters, and the relay's data.v is "2". A format-2 nudge may carry data.stale / data.staleMore. Pick the format by length; byte 0 must agree.
